html:
The Sappony are a state recognized tribe of North Carolina, based in Person County on the Virginia border. They claim descent from the Saponi, a Siouan people of the Piedmont of North Carolina and Virginia.

The historic Saponi lived near the Occaneechi and Tutelo, and in the early 1700s gathered with them at Fort Christanna in Virginia. Later they scattered, some joining the Iroquois and others staying in the Piedmont. The modern Sappony share kin ties with free people of color such as the Melungeons. North Carolina first named them the Indians of Person County in 1911.
